coreFindings.finding1: Single-candle displacement does not produce economically viable continuation at 1m (H001: 47.88%).
coreFindings.finding2: Extreme displacement with extreme close exhibits observed relative mean-reversion at 3m (H002: 52.22%), but falls short of P_BE (55.56%).
coreFindings.finding3: Observed directional asymmetry (H002 vs Reversed: +4.84 pp) is statistically distinct under block resampling, but does not cross the economic hurdle.
coreFindings.finding4: No mega-sample aggregation performed; experiments maintained as strictly independent evidence.
